dish_name_kh: ស្ងោរប្រហិតត្រីស្ពៃក្តោប
dish_name_en: Sngor Fish Ball Soup with Napa Cabbage

ingredients.raw_kh: ស្លឹកខ្ទឹម

steps.text_kh: ត្រីស្លាតត្រូវវះជាពីរ រួចយកទៅកោសយកសាច់ យកអំបិលម្រេចម៉ដ្ឋ ម្សៅស៊ុបដាក់ចូលច្របាច់ឱ្យឡើង ដាំទឹកឱ្យពុះ
steps.text_en: Split the snakehead fish and scrape out the meat; mix with salt, pepper, and soup powder; bring water to a boil.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Sngor Fish Ball Soup with Napa Cabbage, step 1: Split the snakehead fish and scrape out the meat; mix with salt, pepper, and soup powder; bring water to a boil.

steps.text_kh: លញ់ជាប្រហិតមូលៗបង់សម្លរទើបចាក់ទឹកត្រី អំបិល ស្ករ ដាក់ហៃប៊ីបង់សម្លរជាមួយឱ្យចេញជាតិ
steps.text_en: Shape into round fish balls and add to the soup; season with fish sauce, salt, and sugar; add lily buds for aroma.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Sngor Fish Ball Soup with Napa Cabbage, step 2: Shape into round fish balls and add to the soup; season with fish sauce, salt, and sugar; add lily buds for aroma.

steps.text_kh: ចិតស្ពៃក្តោបលាងឱ្យស្អាតបង់ចូលចំនួនពីរឬបីអំពុះ ដាក់ម្សៅស៊ុប ម្រេចម៉ដ្ឋ មុនដាក់ចុះត្រូវហាន់ស្លឹកខ្ទឹមបង់ចូល ភ្លក់មើលឱ្យល្មមសឹមដាក់ចុះជាក្រោយ
steps.text_en: Shred and wash napa cabbage; boil two or three times; add soup powder and pounded pepper; slice lemongrass and add before serving; taste and adjust.
steps.contextualized_text_en: For the Khmer samlor dish Sngor Fish Ball Soup with Napa Cabbage, step 3: Shred and wash napa cabbage; boil two or three times; add soup powder and pounded pepper; slice lemongrass and add before serving; taste and adjust.
